description: Land Title Settlement Department - Inamaluwa, Dambulla D/S Division, Matale District - Cad. Map No. 310009
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, extents, ownership details, and land classifications. The content focuses entirely on land registration and property ownership matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4). There are no government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other non-land related administrative matters present.
